about_the_game:
Long ago, there was a group of scholars on a journey.
They searched not for wisdom, but for a doorway.
A method to gain entry into the sacred realm where no mortal was meant to tread.

They were approached by a stranger offering this forbidden knowledge.
A powerful god who guided them along a mysterious path.
But the god was not granting a gift.

It was delivering a punishment.

What they entered was not heaven, but a place of decay.
A hollow reflection devoid of life, a colorless sky filled with nothing but vibrant ash drifting through the stagnant air.

What happened next changes with each telling.
But always, one left.
And the others remained behind.

Three girls chased that same ancient myth.
They met strangers at the end of a long, overgrown path.
A door to another plane was opened.

And with one misstep, their lives were shattered.

Ten years have passed since that event took place, and what begins as a quiet visit turns into something much heavier. 

Two voices reach out to you for help, both claiming to know what really happened and insisting the other cannot be trusted. Their stories conflict, their motives are unclear, and at the heart of it all lies a girl who hasn’t spoken in a decade.

Who you trust, what you uncover, and how you choose to act will determine who is saved… and who is left behind.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed: Violence, blood, suicide.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5 (6th Gen)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or better (M1 GPU / Iris Plus)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i7 (8th Gen)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 GPU or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

name: Ashen Reverie

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 760 / RX 550 or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (8th Gen) or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RX 580 or better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A dedicated GPU is recommended for best performance.

short_description: You’ve ignored the hallucinations for years. But after visiting a shrine in search of answers, a stranger claims she sees them too. Ashen Reverie is a supernatural thriller visual novel about the consequences of chasing a myth too far.
